name: Edge-Centric Clique Definition
description: Instead of asking for a trio of vertices that have three edges among them (which models easily map to a triangle), the problem now asks for three distinct edges that collectively span exactly three vertices. Mathematically, in a simple graph, this strictly implies a triangle. However, it shifts the NLP pattern away from vertex-centric subgraph descriptions, defeating models that rely on standard graph terminology mappings while remaining logically identical.
